parameters.name: share
parameters.description: An optional share name. If this is unset then the "schema" field of the connection is used in its place.

parameters.name: share_type
parameters.description: An optional share type name. If this is unset then it will assume a posix share type.

parameters.name: source_bucket
parameters.description: The source Google Cloud Storage bucket where the object is. (templated)

parameters.name: source_object
parameters.description: The source name of the object to copy in the Google cloud storage bucket. (templated) You can use only one wildcard for objects (filenames) within your bucket. The wildcard can appear inside the object name or at the end of the object name. Appending a wildcard to the bucket name is unsupported.

parameters.name: destination_path
parameters.description: The SMB remote path. This is the specified directory path in the SMB share name for uploading files to the SMB server.

parameters.name: keep_directory_structure
parameters.description: (Optional) When set to False the path of the file on the bucket is recreated within path passed in destination_path.

parameters.name: move_object
parameters.description: When move object is True, the object is moved instead of copied to the new location. This is the equivalent of a mv command as opposed to a cp command.

parameters.name: gcp_conn_id
parameters.description: (Optional) The connection ID used to connect to Google Cloud.

parameters.name: samba_conn_id
parameters.description: The SMB connection id. The name or identifier for establishing a connection to the SMB server.

parameters.name: impersonation_chain
parameters.description: Optional service account to impersonate using short-term credentials, or chained list of accounts required to get the access_token of the last account in the list, which will be impersonated in the request. If set as a string, the account must grant the originating account the Service Account Token Creator IAM role. If set as a sequence, the identities from the list must grant Service Account Token Creator IAM role to the directly preceding identity, with first account from the list granting this role to the originating account (templated).

parameters.name: buffer_size
parameters.description: Optional specification of the size in bytes of the chunks sent to Samba. Larger buffer lengths may decrease the time to upload large files. The default length is determined by shutil, which is 64 KB.
